# awscc_licensemanagerusersubscriptions_license_server_endpoint (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::LicenseManagerUserSubscriptions::LicenseServerEndpoint



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) The timestamp when License Manager created the license server endpoint.
- `identity_provider_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that identifies the registered identity provider the license server endpoint is created for. For Active Directory, that can be a self-managed Active Directory or an AWS Managed Microsoft AD.
- `license_server_endpoint_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the license server endpoint.
- `license_server_endpoint_id` (String) The ID of the license server endpoint.
- `license_server_endpoint_provisioning_status` (String) The current state of the provisioning process for the license server endpoint.
- `license_server_settings` (Attributes) The settings of the RDS license server to create the endpoint for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--license_server_settings))
- `license_servers` (Attributes List) The license servers that are accessed through this endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--license_servers))
- `server_endpoint` (Attributes) The network address of a license server endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_endpoint))
- `server_type` (String) The type of license server.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags that apply for the license server endpoint. A maximum of 50 tags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--license_server_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `license_server_settings`

Read-Only:

- `server_settings` (Attributes) The settings of a license server, by server type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--license_server_settings--server_settings))
- `server_type` (String) The type of license server.

<a id="nestedatt--license_server_settings--server_settings--rds_sal_settings--rds_sal_credentials_provider"></a>

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--license_server_settings--server_settings--rds_sal_settings--rds_sal_credentials_provider--secrets_manager_credentials_provider"></a>

Read-Only:

- `secret_id` (String) The identifier of the Secrets Manager secret that holds the license server administrator credentials. The name of the secret must begin with the prefix license-manager-user-.
